title: Articles in Biology: a, an, the and zero article
objective: Students fix article problems common in Thai-English biology writing.
context: First mention: ___ insect landed on a leaf. Later: ___ insect moved away. General fact: ___ insects have six legs.

items.prompt: Fill the gap in the first sentence. Explain your choice.
items.answer: An insect. First mention, one item, vowel sound.

items.prompt: Fill the gap in the second sentence. Explain your choice.
items.answer: The insect. It is the same insect already named.
items.hint: Is the reader meeting this animal for the first time?

items.prompt: Write the general fact. Decide if the gap needs an article.
items.answer: Insects have six legs. General plural; no article.
items.hint: The sentence refers to a whole group.
